acknowledgement.description:
Actual acknowledgement when observed. Absence remains unproved: it does
not establish that publication was never issued or cannot still complete.

operation.description: Original operation identity, never replaced with a fresh issue.

problem.description: Original problem identity carried by the source publication or refusal.
